description: Saves a document to a new file, which it then is (not a copy). Refuses an existing file unless overwrite. References issued before keep working. Checked on disk: the file was written by this call.

document.description: The document: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

path.description: Full path of the new file, in an existing folder, with the document's own extension (.SLDPRT for a part).

overwrite.description: Replace the file if it exists. Default false.
